snippet.title: Compass - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore long lost skies in Compass, an open-world piloting adventure about finding your way through uncharted clouds. Maneuver your ship through hazardous floating landscapes, solve puzzles with your grapples, upgrade your vessel, and lead the Caravan forward.

Coming out on May 28th 2026.

Pre-Order now for a 25% discount on Meta Quest!

Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/compass/7364112793688009/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4381560/Compass/
Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019146
